verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents collecting card and bank details in your own UI and charging through the API, which avoids its hosted-page redirect. It also mentions SDKs with "prebuilt UIs", but nothing says these are embeddable in-site components or that they can be customized. missing for 10: explicit documentation of embeddable/inline payment components, customization options (styling, fields) for prebuilt UIs, mobile SDK component details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Collect card, bank, and other payment details with your own UI, then charge the customer through the API.
You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
